ingredients.name: Few dashes each - Nutmeg; Cayenne; Paprika
ingredients.originalText: A few dashes each - Nutmeg; Cayenne; Paprika

instructions.text: Read the entire method first and measure the following ingredients before turning on the heat: 4 cups Brown Rice, cooked; 2 lbs raw Spinach, chopped; 1 cup Onion, chopped; 2 cloves Garlic, minced; 3 Tbsp Butter; 4 Eggs, beaten; 1 cup Milk; 1 1/2 cups Cheddar, grated; 1/4 cup Parsley, chopped; 2 Tbsp Tamari; 1/2 tsp Salt (or more, to taste); 1/4 cup Sunflower Seeds; A few dashes each - Nutmeg; Cayenne; Paprika. Keep ingredients marked optional separate until their step.

Prepare these ingredients before cooking: Raw Spinach: chopped; Onion: chopped; Garlic: minced; Eggs: beaten; Cheddar: grated; Parsley: chopped. Wash produce under running water before cutting. Use a cutting board and a sharp knife; keep raw meat and its utensils separate from ready-to-eat ingredients.
Saute onions and garlic with salt in butter. Stir frequently so the ingredients soften evenly without sticking or burning; reduce the heat if they darken too quickly.
When onions are soft, add spinach.
Combine with all ingredients except sunflower seeds and paprika.
Spread into buttered casserole dish and sprinkle sunflower seeds and paprika on top.

Before serving, check the center of the cooked egg mixture with a food thermometer: it must reach 160°F (71°C), with no runny raw egg. For a casserole containing reheated cooked meat, use 165°F (74°C). Continue cooking if needed.

Turn off any burners or oven when cooking is finished. Follow the cooling or resting instruction above before cutting or serving. Serve the finished dish as directed; allow hot portions to cool enough to eat.

source.author: Joel Maxuel
source.originalInstructions:
1. Saute onions and garlic with salt in butter.  When onions are soft, add spinach. Cook 2 minutes.
2. Combine with all ingredients except sunflower seeds and paprika.
3. Spread into buttered casserole dish and sprinkle sunflower seeds and paprika on top.
4. Bake, covered, 35 minutes at 350F.
